name: VLC Media Player
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Video & Audio File Player
descriptionText: Control video roll-ins, playback pause/resume, stop, fullscreen, and playlist item triggers on VLC Media Player via HTTP / TCP interface.

setupFields.label: VLC Host / IP
setupFields.helpText: Enter IP address of computer running VLC.

setupFields.label: HTTP Web Port
setupFields.helpText: Configured under VLC Preferences > All > Main Interfaces > Lua HTTP.

actions.title: VLC: Play / Pause
actions.subtitle: Toggle video playback
actions.descriptionText: Toggles play/pause state of active media in VLC.

actions.title: VLC: Next Video / Item
actions.subtitle: Skip to next playlist item
actions.descriptionText: Advances VLC playlist to next video clip.

actions.title: VLC: Get Status
actions.subtitle: Query playback state & volume
actions.descriptionText: Fetches current playback state (playing, paused, stopped) and volume from VLC Media Player.
